title: Ordinary GUI apps launched into decade misbehave
body:
Jack tried Launch from the palette on 2026-11-07 with ordinary GUI apps. Some opened as a pane and worked. Some opened misaligned in their pane, some drew wrongly, and Chrome and the ChatGPT app never appeared in decade at all. Jack chose not to chase this for now. Apps that know about decade matter more than ones that don't.

These are likely causes, read from the code and not checked against any app:

- `render` in `src/server/compositor.rs` draws each client's surface tree at its pane's origin. It ignores the window geometry an xdg toplevel sets with `set_window_geometry`, so an app with client-side shadows or decorations sits offset in its pane.
- `new_popup` is empty, so menus, tooltips and dropdowns never appear.
- Chromium-based apps and some GTK apps hand a launch to an instance that is already running outside decade, so no window opens inside it.
close_reason: Window geometry and configure states fixed in bf36ffa on dev. The note on this issue has the retest. Obsidian's fixed-size welcome window and Chrome's handoff to an instance outside decade remain as described there.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/575e4e76
notes.text: Until 60ddbe2, decade's dmabuf global carried no feedback, so a client's Mesa had no GPU to open and could fall back to software rendering. That broke ghostty at large sizes. Some of the misbehaviour listed in this issue may have had the same cause, so the apps are worth trying again.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/f5ffdd3d
notes.text:
A retest on 2026-11-12, with an isolated server and `decade script`, launched each app from the palette.

| app | toolkit | before this change | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| Files (Nautilus) | GTK4 | fits | fits |
| CMake | Qt | fits, menus placed right | not retested |
| Papers | GTK4 | offset about 30 px, right edge cropped | fits |
| LocalSend | Flutter on GTK3 | offset and cropped | fits |
| Obsidian | Electron | offset and cropped | cropped, see below |
| Chrome, ChatGPT | Chromium | slight offset, with an isolated profile | not retested |

Two decade causes, both fixed on `dev` and not yet committed:

- `paint_clients` in `decade/src/server/compositor/render.rs` and pointer focus in `decade/src/server/compositor/input.rs` put the toplevel's buffer corner at the pane's corner. They now subtract `window_origin`, the corner of the window geometry. `popups_over` and `place_popup` now measure from the window geometry's corner, as smithay's offsets do.
- `configure` sent only `Activated`, so an app could treat the size as a hint. LocalSend took 656 by 828, then restored a saved 900 by 637. `configure` now also sets `Maximized` and the four tiled states.

Obsidian with no vault opens a welcome window whose minimum and maximum size are both 820 by 670. It cannot shrink to a narrower pane, so decade crops it. Its vault window is resizable.

Chrome and ChatGPT never appeared in decade in the first report because Chrome was already running outside decade, and a launch went to that instance. With `--user-data-dir` pointing at a fresh profile, both open in a pane. decade does not change this.

The popups and the old dmabuf fallback named in the issue body were fixed in `803bdf7` and `60ddbe2`.
